earnings.title: 1201 S. Second Street
highlights: Fourth quarter diluted EPS of $3.11 and Adjusted EPS of $3.88; up 153% and 16% year over year, respectively
Full year fiscal 2026 diluted EPS of $12.54 and Adjusted EPS of $13.42; up 63% and 27% year over year, respectively
Fourth quarter reported sales up 1%; organic sales up 3% year over year; both reduced by ~(4) percentage points from the customer tariff refund program
Full year reported and organic sales up 8% year over year; both reduced by ~(1) percentage point from the customer tariff refund program
Full year fiscal 2026 cash provided by operating activities of $1,958 million and free cash flow of $1,701 million; up 27% and 25% year over year, respectively

quotes.text: Rockwell delivered a strong finish to a great year, with broad-based topline growth, margin expansion, and double-digit earnings growth.

items.heading: Adverse changes in macroeconomic or industry conditions may result in decreases in our sales and profitability.
Our profitability and market competitiveness may be adversely impacted by changes in trade policies, including tariffs or other factors.

We face the potential harms of natural disasters, including those as a result of climate change, pandemics, acts of war, terrorism, international conflicts, or other disruptions to our operations, the duration and severity of which are highly uncertain and difficult to predict.
Volatility and disruption of the capital and credit markets may result in increased costs to maintain our capital structure.

Failures or security breaches of our commercial product offerings (which includes hardware, software, services, and solutions), manufacturing environment, supply chain, or information and operational technology systems could have an adverse effect on our business.
An inability to successfully execute cost productivity and margin expansion initiatives could negatively impact our business and financial results.
